offers_products.reason: Makes precision motors, drives, controls and power quality products sold as components and integrated systems.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from engineered motion, controls and power hardware; no main service offering is described.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells to OEMs, system integrators and end users in aerospace, defense, medical, industrial and vehicles.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Main buyers are OEMs and system integrators across aerospace, defense, medical, industrial and vehicle markets.

recurring_revenue.reason: Engineered components sold per OEM program and order, not subscriptions or contracts, so revenue is mostly project-driven.

cyclical_demand.reason: Industrial and vehicle OEMs can cut or delay motor, drive and controls orders in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Motors, drives and components are mid-priced parts bought repeatedly in production volumes, not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured motors, drives and controls, not for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Serves OEMs and system integrators in aerospace, defense, medical and vehicles, which are mostly large enterprises.

asset_heavy.reason: Runs many small to mid-size component plants; it is not capital-intensive like heavy manufacturing.

notes: Customer size and capital intensity are partly inferred; asset-heavy is borderline for a multi-plant manufacturer.
